The treatment system consists of an influent diversion box, three equalization tanks, an automatic bar screen, an oxidation ditch, and a secondary clarifier.
The wastewater undergoes biological treatment in the oxidation ditch, followed by solids separation in the secondary clarifier.
The wastewater undergoes biological treatment in the oxidation ditch, followed by solids separation in the secondary clarifier.
Wastewater is disinfected in the chlorine contact chamber by injecting sodium hypochlorite followed by dechlorination using sodium bisulfite.

A portion of the solids separated in the secondary clarifier is pumped back to the oxidation ditch for additional treatment and the remaining portion is pumped to one of six drying beds, dried, and placed in trash bins prior to being hauled away by a contractor (currently, Allied Waste Services) to the Allied Waste Imperial Landfill (Imperial, CA) for disposal.
